description: An all-in-one SEO platform providing programmatic access and tools for keyword ranking, competitor analysis, website audits, and backlink tracking.
auth_notes: Authentication is performed using an API key retrieved from the API section under user account settings.
credential_notes: API access is included with SE Ranking subscriptions and can be tested during the free trial; pay-as-you-go and paid add-ons are also available.
api_notes: Covers keyword research, backlink analysis, domain performance, website audits, rank tracking, and project management via structured JSON REST endpoints.
mcp_notes: SE Ranking provides an official MCP server to query SEO data directly from AI assistants like Claude, Cursor, and Gemini.
rationale: The API and MCP server are fully documented, publicly accessible, and available with self-serve credentials included in plans or trial accounts.

evidence.note: Documentation explains logging into the account settings to retrieve the unique API key.
Confirms API access is included with subscription plans and can be tested during the free trial or via pay-as-you-go.
Details comprehensive REST endpoints for keyword research, backlinks, domain analysis, and website audits.
Provides documentation and instructions for the official SE Ranking MCP server integration.

changes: Added 'api_key' to auth_methods, updated credential_access to 'self_serve_trial' based on trial availability, changed buildability to 'ready_now' with blocker 'none', and referenced working documentation URLs.
